decisions.summary: Hayakawa's house about 65 tsubo (kitchen, bath, corridor counted), top of 0091's range as a GUESS for the RICH knob; room zones GUESS
decisions.why: FR-001: the house within 49-67 tsubo; the GM: 'the third magistracy should be corrected'. Placing it at the top of the range for a rich posting is a choice inside the range, labeled GUESS.

decisions.summary: Hayakawa's inner court laid out again around the smaller house: alley, privies, roji, kitchen ell, bath, inner entrance, storehouses, woodshed, karo's house, vegetable garden, shrine moved
decisions.why: FR-001: 'whatever on the Hayakawa sheet does not correspond to the research is brought to it'; the request: 'whatever other changes need to be made should be made'. Re-laying the court around a house a third its size is the consequence of the correction, not a new scope; the karo's house is kept at its measured 0118 size.

decisions.summary: Hayakawa's north wall moved 30 ft south (envelope a knob), guests' annex with it, coverage to about 30.6%
decisions.why: Departs from the standing 'envelope NOT shrunk' rule for this sheet. The question put to the GM told him a redraw drops coverage to 27-28%, under 0116's band; he chose the redraw and added 'whatever other changes need to be made should be made in order to make the whole thing correspond to our research'. 0116's band is research, and FR-001/SC-001 require the sheet inside it. The alternatives are priced: a recorded deviation is forbidden by SC-001, inflating buildings past research sizes defeats the request's own purpose, west/east walls are physically blocked by the gate range and outer court. The rule's purpose (a smaller wall must not hide slack) is not gutted: the program is research-sized and cannot be grown honestly. Owed, not ruled: the notes call the envelope 'the audited Joge<->Takayama size, a range'; the plan does not state the shrunk envelope still sits inside that range, and T01 should measure and say so, or else record what it leaves.

decisions.summary: The standing rule amended for magistracy sheets: when the research resizes the program, the envelope follows the coverage band (docs/buildings.md checklist, coverage-check messages, the test pinning the text)
decisions.why: As applied to magistracy sheets this is authorized in the GM's words: 'we should correct our general procedures when creating new magistracy diagrams in order to correspond to our research'; FR-003 requires a new sheet kept within 0116's band, 'how, the plan's'. Without it the procedure would order a research-sized house inside Ochiba's 141-tsubo envelope and land under the band.

decisions.summary: The same amendment's reach as worded: 'when the research resizes A SHEET'S program, the envelope follows it', in the shared coverage-check messages (pack_audit/shared.py, registry.py) and the general checklist - every sheet type, not magistracies
decisions.why: Nothing in request.md speaks to any sheet but the three magistracies and 'new magistracy diagrams'. 'Whatever other changes NEED to be made' covers what this correction needs; neither Hayakawa's redraw nor the magistracy procedure needs a standing rule relaxed for temples, farmhouses or any other compound. Generalizing it is completing the GM's thought. Fix: word the amended checklist line and both messages (and the pinned test) for a magistracy sheet whose house the research sizes, not 'a sheet's program'; or put the general form to the GM.

decisions.summary: T01 Approach item 2: 'The outer court is not touched.'
decisions.why: FR-001 and SC-001 sweep the whole Hayakawa sheet ('whatever on the Hayakawa sheet does not correspond to the research is brought to it'; 'every element of the sheet the research speaks to corresponds to it'). The plan measured coverage and the karo's house but records no check of the outer court against the research, so excluding it rests on an unmeasured premise. As a layout constraint (the outer court is not moved to make room, which D3's pricing of (c) and (d) relies on) it is within; as worded it cuts FR-001's scope. Fix: 'the outer court is not moved to make room; FR-001's correspondence sweep over it is still owed through building-review'.

decisions.summary: The house keeps its recorded forms (echelon of two blocks, reception at the east end, roji, kitchen ell, veranda faces)
decisions.why: Corrects the size the GM asked corrected and keeps the forms nothing in the request or research is said to contradict; building-review remains the occasion for the sheet.

decisions.summary: docs/buildings.md :17 and :23, Ochiba notes :65 and Ubame notes :109 say DEVIATION with the GM's reason (about 141 and 152 tsubo); Hayakawa's figure becomes ~65 tsubo
decisions.why: FR-002 verbatim: 'two of them should stay the same as recorded deviations, because ... significantly wealthier magistrates than normal'. No ink changes on either sheet (T02 constraint) matches 'stay the same'.

decisions.summary: docs/building-programs.md residence bullet and a docs/buildings.md checklist line state 49-67 tsubo, a larger house only as a recorded deviation, envelope follows the band; docs/usage.md keeps Ochiba as template for conventions and drawing but says its house is a deviation not to be copied
decisions.why: FR-003 and the GM: 'correct our general procedures when creating new magistracy diagrams'. FR-003 removes Ochiba only as the model for the house's size; keeping it as the template for other conventions is inside that. The envelope clause here is magistracy-scoped (D3b), not the general reach of D3c.

decisions.summary: 0116's drawing page sentence gives each compound's measured coverage on its date, Ochiba re-measured too
decisions.why: The record states Hayakawa's coverage (35%), which the redraw changes; making the record match the measured sheet is part of 'make the whole thing correspond to our research'. Re-measuring Ochiba's stated figure is the standing measure-not-remember rule on a figure already in the record, not new scope.

decisions.summary: Hayakawa house about 65 tsubo (about 2,330 sq ft), near the top of a 49-tsubo to ~2,400 sq ft (~67 tsubo) range, the range's top re-cited to 0118's senior house instead of the Kuchiba/Matsue houses; placing a RICH posting near the top is a GUESS recorded on 0091's drawing page; room zones GUESS.
decisions.why: The request asks for the third magistracy corrected to the research, framed as a 49-67 tsubo house; FR-001/SC-001 require a house within 49-67 tsubo. About 65 tsubo is inside that range; the re-citation of the range's ceiling and the GUESS about where in the range a RICH posting sits choose a point inside what was asked and narrow nothing. The pass rests on one premise, unchanged since the CLEAR verdict and attributed to research (0091's drawing page counts the kitchen in the house, R1 the bath): without the kitchen and bath the two blocks are about 1,600 sq ft, about 45 tsubo, under the range. With them, 36x25.3 + 27.3x25.3 + 24x18 + 18x12 is about 2,250 sq ft, so 2,330 implies about 80 sq ft of corridor, about 65.5 tsubo - consistent (this review's arithmetic on the block's own dimensions).

decisions.summary: Inner court laid out again around the smaller house and the moved north wall (service alley, privies, kitchen ell, bath, entrance, storehouses, woodshed, karo's house, vegetable garden, shrine). Unchanged since its CLEAR verdict.
decisions.why: The GM: 'whatever other changes need to be made should be made in order to make the whole thing correspond to our research'. Re-laying the court around the corrected house is that, each element kept on its research form or knob.

decisions.summary: The north wall moves 30 ft south (walled ground about 45,200 sq ft, coverage 30.4%, inside 0116's band), recorded as a DEVIATION from 0116's drawing page, which keeps a sparse compound's walls where they are; alternatives (a)-(d) priced.
decisions.why: The request is that the whole sheet correspond to the research; a recorded deviation from 0116's drawing page is an exception to that and is ruled as one. It is legitimate: (1) the full rule is impossible here - a research-sized house inside the existing walls leaves coverage at about 27-28%, under 0116's band, which SC-001 forbids; inflating buildings breaks their research sizes; the west and east walls cannot give 36 ft by the plan's arithmetic - so some point of the research must give, and the plan prices every alternative; (2) the GM's own words imply it: he was told that coverage would fall under 0116's band and answered that 'whatever other changes need to be made should be made' to correspond to the research, which names changes beyond the house; (3) purpose test - the purpose (the house and the compound's density matching the research) survives: the house sits in 0091's range, coverage in 0116's band, and the walls still fall between the Joge and Takayama offices 0116 sizes them against, the envelope being a number no page measures. The relabel from 'a knob' to a DEVIATION recorded with its reason and chooser is the more honest statement of the same move, not a new carve-out. Two readings the ruling chooses rather than misses: (i) the GM set the two sheets that 'stay the same as recorded deviations' against the third that 'should be corrected'; a session-chosen recorded deviation on the corrected sheet is acceptable only because it is forced (the band and 0116's keep-the-walls rule cannot both hold with a research-sized house) and it lands on the one element no page measures, not on the house he asked about - it is not a deviation the GM approved; (ii) SC-001 names the house's range and the band explicitly and then requires 'every element of the sheet the research speaks to' to correspond; option (a) breaks a named measure, the wall move breaks a procedural rule whose number no page gives, and this ruling reads the catch-all as reaching measured sizes and bands first. Were that reading wrong, the plan would depart from the accepted spec and need a spec amendment. The impossibility of options (c) and (d) is taken on the plan's own arithmetic as stated; the bundle carries no run of it.

decisions.summary: The checklist's 'envelope NOT shrunk' and the coverage check's 'never shrink the envelope' amended for a magistracy sheet alone (docs/buildings.md, docs/building-programs.md, pack_audit messages, the test pinning the text); every other sheet type keeps the rule. Unchanged since its CLEAR verdict.
decisions.why: The GM: 'we should correct our general procedures when creating new magistracy diagrams in order to correspond to our research' (FR-003). The amendment is that correction, scoped to the magistracies his words reach; the test only pins the requested text.

decisions.summary: Re-answer for the labeling pass after impl-drift and the preflight: every rendering decision labeled in research/, the operative doc, the point of change and the spec; a departure from the research is never written into the procedure as its default; labels before landing, no ink changes; done = impl-drift IN-STEP on the changed claims and the record's checks on 0091 and 0116 recorded; exits through make arbiter-ask
decisions.why: It decides how the labels the GM's 'correspond to our research' requires are carried, and its constraint 2 states the very rule the preflight's D3b finding asked for. 'No ink changes' scopes this pass to labels; it does not relax SC-001, which still binds the sheet (house 49-67 tsubo, coverage in 0116's band, reviews passed) through the spec. Nothing in it narrows the request.

decisions.summary: Hayakawa's north wall moves 30 ft south (walled ~45,200 sq ft, coverage 30.4%), a DEVIATION from 0116's drawing page recorded there with its reason and who chose it; alternatives (a)-(d) priced
decisions.why: Text unchanged since its last ruling. The GM was told in the question that a 67-tsubo house drops coverage under 0116's band and still asked for the correction and 'whatever other changes need to be made'; with the house fixed by FR-001 and SC-001 requiring the band, 0116's band and 0116's wall-keeping cannot both hold on this sheet. The block prices the alternatives, follows the requirement the spec names, and labels the departure on the page.

decisions.summary: Standing procedure for MAGISTRACY sheets only (docs/buildings.md checklist, docs/building-programs.md magistracy program, pack_audit shared.py/registry.py messages and their pinning test): 'never shrink the envelope' kept, amended so a wall moves in only as a DEVIATION and never a default - only when a house at the record's size leaves coverage under the band and no other wall and no building can honestly close it - each move recorded on 0116's drawing page with its reason and who chose it; other sheet types unchanged
decisions.why: This is the remedy the preflight's NOT LEGITIMATE ruling named, adopted as written. The procedure no longer makes a departure from 0116 the unlabeled default: the default stays 0116's (walls kept), and the departure is permitted only under the same forced conflict that makes D3a legitimate (house at the research's size, coverage under the band, no wall and no research-sized building able to close it), with the same per-sheet DEVIATION record. That is what 'correct our general procedures when creating new magistracy diagrams in order to correspond to our research' asks: the procedure sizes the house by the research and, where the research's own two rules collide, records which gave and why rather than hiding it. Each of its parts was adjudicated: the trigger condition (narrow and tied to the conflict), the recording (on 0116's page, as D3a), and the reach (magistracy sheets only, the plan round 1 ruling, unchanged). 'Honestly' must be read as at research sizes, which D3a's (b) states; the procedure text should carry that meaning when written.

decisions.why: ~2,400 sq ft is ~67 tsubo at 35.58 sq ft/tsubo, so the re-cited top does not widen FR-001's 49-67; 65 tsubo is inside it. The amendment changes the citation, not the size. Placing a RICH posting at the top of the range stays inside the range FR-001 requires, and FR-004 owns the naming question. Every figure carries a GUESS label or a research cite.

decisions.summary: Inner court relaid behind the new north wall: service alley, privies, reception and roji, kitchen ell, bath, inner entrance, storehouses, woodshed, karo's house, vegetable garden, shrine
decisions.why: Unchanged since its CLEAR verdict; it is the 'whatever other changes need to be made' the GM asked for, each form cited or labeled GUESS.

decisions.summary: Hayakawa's north wall moves 30 ft south (walled ground ~45,200 sq ft, coverage 30.4%), recorded as a DEVIATION from 0116's drawing page (which keeps a sparse compound's walls) with its reason and who chose it
decisions.why: It narrows SC-001's 'every element the research speaks to corresponds to it' on the one sheet the GM said to correct. But the GM was told in the question itself that a 67-tsubo house drops coverage to 27-28%, under 0116's band, and answered that whatever other changes are needed should be made to make the whole correspond to the research; FR-001/SC-001 then require coverage inside the band. With the house fixed at 49-67 and the walls kept, 0116's band and 0116's wall-keeping cannot both hold: one piece of the research must give. The block prices the alternatives - (a) under the band, which SC-001 forbids; (b) buildings drawn past their research sizes; (c) and (d) the west or east wall in, both physically blocked - and neither the spec nor the request gives grounds for adding buildings. So the conflict is real, the choice follows the requirement the spec names explicitly, and the departure is labeled on the page with its reason and who chose it rather than hidden as a knob.

decisions.summary: Standing procedure amended for every MAGISTRACY sheet: 'when the research sizes a magistracy's house, the envelope follows it into the band' (docs/buildings.md checklist, docs/building-programs.md magistracy program, pack_audit/shared.py and registry.py messages, the pinning test); other sheet types keep 'never shrink the envelope'
decisions.why: The amendment changed what this rests on. When it was last judged (CLEAR), the shrink rested on 'the envelope is a number no page measures - a knob', which made the procedure change a design choice inside 'correct our general procedures'. D3 now says 0116's drawing page DOES speak to it (it keeps a sparse compound's walls where they are) and that the move departs from it. Yet the same block writes that move into the general procedure as the default for every magistracy sheet, with no DEVIATION label and no per-sheet recording. The GM asked that the procedures be corrected 'in order to correspond to our research'. A procedure that makes a labeled departure from the research the unlabeled default does the opposite, and it extends one sheet's forced conflict to sheets that may never face it. The block cannot have both: if the shrink is a deviation from 0116, the procedure text must require each magistracy shrink to be recorded as a DEVIATION on 0116's drawing page with its reason and who chose it, as D3a does, and allow it only when the house-sized-to-research leaves coverage under the band with no wall/building option. If instead the author holds that a NEW sheet's envelope set to the band at drawing time is not the redraw-shrink 0116's page speaks to, the procedure must say so and cite where 0116 supports it. The scope limit to magistracy sheets (plan round 1) is unchanged and is not what fails here.
